description: Discover the G-Force RE, a foldable all-terrain electric bike with a 20AH battery offering up to 75 miles range. Built with dual suspension for enhanced comfort, 4-inch fat tires for stability on all surfaces, and 75Nm torque for powerful performance, this folding ebike is perfect for both city commutes and rugged adventures. Stylish, durable, and easy to store, the G-Force RE redefines long-range electric biking.

components.description: The front wheel features a Thru Axle wheel attachment system for tool-free installation. This feature ensures a straight wheel, consistent brake rotor alignment, and handling stability. Remove the wheel in minutes for easy and light-weight transport

The dual mechanical disc brakes provide reliable and consistent stopping power, ensuring safety and control in various riding conditions. With precise modulation, they enhance braking efficiency on steep slopes and rough terrains, offering a smooth and responsive riding experience.
The RE's KMC Z8 steel chain offers consistent tension and secure performance throughout your ride.
14-28 tooth, 7-geared freewheel
Forged aluminum, 48-tooth chainring with dual-sided chainring guard is the perfect match for 20-inch fat tires.
Shimano derailleur
Sleek tube battery design, securely built into the frame for enhanced safety and stability. Durable, dustproof, and waterproof with extended range. Easily removable for convenient charging anywhere.

48V, 2.0A, operates on 100V-240V AC power outlets, 5-8 hr charging. A charging port on the bottom of the integrated battery provides riders with the option to charge the eBike without removing the battery. Meanwhile, interchangeable spare batteries can be removed and installed in seconds, doubling your range.
A backlit, heads-up LCD color display provides trip and battery intelligence on the go. lP-65-rated electrical components ensure greater water and dust resistance.
A 750W rear hub motor (1300W Peak) with 85Nm of torque delivers power and speed quicker than ever before to help you conquer rough terrains with ease.

The adjustable front fork boasts a high-strength aluminum alloy Dual Suspension(with up to 80mm of travel ) & Hydraulic Lockout which ensures the comfort of riding under any complex cycling conditions.
Soft ergonomic imitation leather comfort grips offer superior comfort, durability, grip, and style, making them a popular choice among cyclists.
1 Toolkit Box
1 Keys
1 Rear Derailleur Guard
A heavy-duty side-sweeping kickstand located near the chain stay keeps the E-Bike upright.
An integrated safety system, featuring a headlamp and taillight powered by the battery allows you to be seen at any time of day.
Quick-release pedals easily detach from the bike for compact transport.

Engineers meticulously craft the Rear Suspension system which consists of four frame link shocks(including two middle air-pressure shocks and two rear spring shock absorbers)—high-quality frame link suspension construction that greatly reduces bumps on uneven surfaces.
260*230mm, comfortable ergonomic seat, allowing you to ride for longer periods equipped with a rear reflector, significantly improving safety.
An adjustable and removable seat post allows riders to reach a range of heights while maintaining comfort and stability.
thumb-triggered handlebar shifter

Compared to the handlebar throttle, the half twist throttle design is more ergonomic, offering a natural and comfortable operation that reduces hand fatigue and discomfort, thus enhancing safety and comfort during rides.

Two fat tires paired with an integrated wheel design provide unparalleled traction and effortless handling on any terrain. The enhanced stability eliminates skidding and slipping, ensuring a smooth and comfortable ride. With the added strength of the integrated wheel, enjoy superior durability and control, no matter where your journey takes you.
A 22 amp controller swiftly distributes power to the motor.
Simply attach the quick-release pedals and install the front wheel via the thru-axle.
